excludedCategories: credentials, environments/private profiles and generated runtime signing material
actual response payloads and private benchmark inputs/outputs
actual database/context/control fixtures and raw or retained job-body captures
internal operational/recovery notes and private proof reports
generated builds/dependencies, runtime state/identity and uncommitted files
recoveryLimits: Integrates a775 request timing and 3e41 nonblocking verified-cache behavior only; other collector candidates are not incorporated.
Only code creating ephemeral process-local HMAC correlation is included; no generated key, live check token or real response is backed up. Correlation is not access authorization.
Same-process routing is required; invalid, expired or cross-process checks terminate FAILED rather than starting a new query.

The initial cold/no-cache path remains strict and has not been accepted against real public traffic. A warm check must be followed with the same correlation through bounded CURRENT verification after a new publication.
A cached response may display an older verified projection; original timing/version must not be mistaken for fresh publication. No five-second freshness guarantee is made.
Excluded historical database and private capture fixtures must be recovered separately for dependent tests.
Original frontend assets and licenses are retained. Build success is not public-browser/mobile or deployment acceptance.
Workflow source remains relocated under backup/disabled-workflows; no automatic CI, merge or deployment.
The sanitized backup commit is a separate identity requiring independent runtime build and registration.
